Part 1 高频 物品 OBJECTS

Websites

网站

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1What kinds of websites do you often visit?

Mostly video and social platforms, I'd say. I spend a lot of time on Bilibili and WeChat Channels, watching tech reviews and short clips. Traditional news websites rarely get a visit from me.

主要是视频和社交平台，最常用哔哩哔哩和微信视频号，看科技评测和短视频。

Q2What is your favourite website?

Definitely Bilibili. It has everything, learning videos, tech reviews and entertainment, so I can always find something that catches my interest. Honestly, I often lose track of time there.

最喜欢哔哩哔哩，学习视频、科技评测、娱乐都有，一刷就忘了时间。

Q3Are there any changes to the websites you often visit?

Yeah, quite a lot, actually. These platforms keep updating their designs and recommendation systems. WeChat Channels, for instance, has grown a lot over the past couple of years, and I've noticed more short videos everywhere.

变化挺大，平台不断更新设计和推荐算法，视频号这几年增长很快，短视频到处都是。

Q4What kinds of websites are popular in your country?

Video and social media platforms are the biggest, without a doubt. Bilibili, Douyin and Xiaohongshu are everywhere, which makes sense because we live in the internet era and people spend so much of their lives online.

视频和社交平台最火，哔哩哔哩、抖音、小红书随处可见，因为现在是互联网时代。
